_note: Interview fixture answers for lets-craft's ask seam (src/ask.ts, src/fixtures.ts), migrated to fixture schema v2 and aligned with the pre-craft skill's question-tagging convention (skills/pre-craft/SKILL.md §1.2): every pre-craft question starts with a bracketed English tag ([Feature Name], [Goal], [Constraints], [Success Criteria], [Context]), and every consensus/escalation/handoff gate ends in an approval suffix such as 'Proceed?'. The five interview-tag rules intentionally use kind 'free-text', which all three ask tools can consume, so runtime choice between lsc_ask and lsc_select does not affect these scripted answers. Select gates use kind 'selection' with canonical labels, while yes/no gates use kind 'confirmation'. Select-gate rules precede the generic proceed-suffix rule because fixture matching is first-hit. R5's always-worktree topology removed the old [Worktree] question entirely. Tag-prefix anchoring avoids loose keyword matches against unrelated prose; the confirmation default remains a fallback for unanticipated yes/no gates in disposable E2E repositories only.
_warning: Do NOT set LSC_FIXTURE to this file (or point it at a copy of it) against a real repository. The catch-all default ({"kind":"confirmation","confirm":true}) affirmatively answers EVERY unmatched lsc_confirm question, including post-craft's [Land] merge approval and its force-remove-worktree escalation. It deliberately errors rather than guessing if an unmatched lsc_ask or lsc_select reaches the confirmation default. This file is only for disposable git repositories created and deleted by test/e2e-helpers.ts.
